title: Negative 4 is at most cosOne -- the matching loose lower bound
statement: CReal.le (-4) CReal.cosOne, the lower-bound twin of cosOne_le_four, via the same reused, loose e-style domination discarding sign cancellation. Together the two facts place cosOne only in [-4,4], nowhere near the sharp cos(1) ~= 0.5403.

formal.statement: theorem CReal.neg_four_le_cosOne : CReal.le (CReal.neg (CReal.mul (CReal.ofRat (Rat.normalize (Int.ofNat (AxNat.succ (AxNat.succ AxNat.zero))) (AxNat.succ AxNat.zero) (AxNat.le.refl (AxNat.succ AxNat.zero)))) (CReal.ofRat (Rat.normalize (Int.ofNat (AxNat.succ (AxNat.succ AxNat.zero))) (AxNat.succ AxNat.zero) (AxNat.le.refl (AxNat.succ AxNat.zero)))))) CReal.cosOne

evidence.supports: CReal.neg_four_le_cosOne is admitted by the trusted kernel gate with the type recorded in formal.statement.
